# WuTools

> WuTools is a comprehensive suite of free, browser-based calculators, converters, and AI-powered tools for everyday tasks.

WuTools offers a diverse collection of utilities spanning calculators (math, finance, health, engineering, HVAC), unit converters (area, color, data, energy, frequency), and AI tools (text summarization, grammar checking, language detection). The platform is available in multiple languages including English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, and Vietnamese.

- [Health Fitness Calculators - BMI, Calorie, Fat | WuTools - WuTools](https://wutools.com/calc/health-fitness): Health calculators: BMI, calorie counter, body fat, WHO growth charts

- [Wire Calculators - AWG Gauge, Resistance, Diameter | WuTools - WuTools](https://wutools.com/calc/wire): Wire calculators for AWG gauge, resistance, diameter specifications

- [Energy Conversion Tools - Joules, BTU, Calories | WuTools - WuTools](https://wutools.com/convert/energy): Energy converter: joules, BTU, calories, kilowatt-hours
- [Frequency Conversion Tools - Hz, kHz, MHz, GHz | WuTools - WuTools](https://wutools.com/convert/frequency): Frequency converter: Hz, kHz, MHz, GHz for radio and audio
- [Electric Charge Converter - Coulombs, Ampere-Hours | WuTools - WuTools](https://wutools.com/convert/charge): Electric charge converter: coulombs, ampere-hours, nanocoulombs
- [Flow Rate Converter - L/s, GPM, m³/h | WuTools - WuTools](https://wutools.com/convert/flow-rate): Flow rate converter: liters/second, GPM, cubic meters/hour
